|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1, the only known text of this card; it is the current text. The images are the Players Committee card image and the release-sheet slip, which both print it. The original text (first printing of the Virtual Block 7.3 sheet, official text as of 3 June 2011) has not been found, so it has no page here.
* '''Original''' (not found): the Players Committee news post of 23 June 2011 says the errata “is simply to accomodate the change to Rogue Insertion. The Rogues are no longer spies, so the text relying on spies being present at the Power Plant needed to be replaced with something achievable for Center of Tyranny.”<ref name="src-S6">Players Committee news post "5 immediate changes from the CBT", 23 June 2011 (immediate). * '''PC-E1''' (this page): given in full in the news post of 23 June 2011 (“Light (1): Attempts to 'disable' the Planetary Shield are +2 for each Rogue Squadron pilot here.
